$comment: Questions the setup skill asks on first install. Answers go into <config-dir>/settings.local.json's env block. Re-run interactively via /claude-tools:setup. Adding a question here makes it auto-prompted on next setup. Personal projects authenticate through `gh auth` and `gcloud auth`, so there are no API tokens to collect here — per-project config lives in the projects.<key> registry, which the personal-projects skill writes.

questions.name: CLAUDE_PRUNE_BASE
questions.prompt: Base branch(es) for git worktrees — pick every base your repos use; the SessionEnd auto-prune hook prunes a worktree when its branch is merged into ANY selected base
questions.$note: Stored as a comma-separated list, e.g. "main,master". Consumers (worktree-manager prune) split on comma.
